validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: Real. EWJZG-1 is a named EPC work package within Aramco's Master Gas System Expansion Phase 3 (MGS III), a USD ~18bn program of 17 EPC packages totaling ~4,153 km of gas transmission pipe, construction Q2 2024 -> completion target Q4 2028. Confirmed by multiple independent sources (Blackridge Research project profile; MEED contractor-award coverage; SICIM corporate project page), none of which trace to GEM. CLASSIFICATION: Correct — this is a dry-gas transmission trunk line on the east-west MGS corridor (PipelineType=transmission, Fuel=Gas both correct). Not an NGL/gathering/feeder line. DUPLICATE: Not a duplicate. All of P6717-P6737 share the umbrella name 'MGS III Gas Pipelines' but are distinct EPC packages/segments. P6731's 462 km / package EWJZG-1 (STS-1 -> Shoqaiq) is a unique segment; the nearest length (P6733=470 km) is a different package. SPEC: Length 462 km — Blackridge AND MEED both state 462 km independently (HIGH). Diameter 56 in — Blackridge confirms 56-inch (also matches GEM); the 56-in figure is corroborated across the package family and Blackridge's per-segment listing (HIGH). Start 2028 — Blackridge gives completion target Q4 2028 (consistent with GEM StartYear1=2028, HIGH). ATTRIBUTION: Owner Aramco confirmed (Blackridge owner/operator = Saudi Aramco; MEED). Per Blackridge the EPC contractor on this package is Max Streicher (Germany) — that is the constructor, not the owner; GEM correctly records Aramco as owner. CAVEAT: endpoints (Sector Two STS-1 origin, Shoqaiq terminus) are documented but the GEM Location [ref] cell was blank — filled below.
